articles.summary: LONDON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 18, 2026-- Pentair plc (NYSE: PNR), a leader in helping the world sustainably move, improve and enjoy water, life’s most essential resource, today announced that Louis Pinkham has been appointed to its board of directors, effective September 17, 2026.
